title: fix(app-shell,plugin-chatbot): repair the three breaks at the AI paywall moment
body:
Fixes #7253

A free plan's second build iteration clicks 确认修改, the cloud guardrail refuses with 429 `AI_DESIGN_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`, and three things go wrong on top of the refusal. All three are fixed here.

## 1. The upgrade CTA opened a 404

`cloudPricingDeepLink()` composed `${cloudBase}/apps/cloud-control/sys_environment`. That guesses three facts owned by whoever deploys the CONTROL PLANE, and misses all three: the console mount (`/_console/`, injected by that host), the app slug (`cloud_control`, not `cloud-control`) and the route (the plan entry is a Page, not the `sys_environment` list). The button landed on the control plane's API 404, `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND"}}`.

Per the dispatch ruling, the destination is not composed client-side. I checked whether the cloud already publishes one and it does not: `/api/v1/runtime/config` carries `cloudUrl` and nothing else about the console; `/api/v1/auth/config` is the auth feature/provider payload; the 429 envelope carries `messageEn` / `upgrade` / `topUp` / `resetsTonight` and no URL. So this PR ships the consumer half at the most specific target we are entitled to name, and the producer half is filed as objectstack-ai/cloud#1850 (which also records that the control plane's own two call sites currently spell this URL two different ways).

- `cloudInstallDeepLink` + `cloudPricingDeepLink` → one `cloudConsoleUrl()`: the runtime-supplied origin, **no path appended**. The console mount claims `/` and redirects to `/_console/` (`mountConsoleStatic`, `rootRedirect` default on), landing the user in the Cloud app whose nav carries Billing.
- The `|| 'https://cloud.objectos.app'` default is gone. A runtime with no upstream cloud has no control plane, and its callers now render **no link at all** rather than bouncing a self-hosted or air-gapped user to the vendor's SaaS. Three call sites gained that guard: the chat's `onUpgrade`, the AI usage ring's CTA, and the marketplace "Open on Cloud" fallback (an `href=""` would have reloaded the page).

**Bounded in-place fix, declared:** the issue asks to check line 420's identical composition (`.../sys_package/<id>`, the marketplace "Open on Cloud" fallback). It is the same defect in the same helper — verified dead the same way — so it is repaired in the same change rather than left pointing at the same 404. Same file, same gate family; the call site is an error fallback, so nothing else moves.

## 2. The confirm card had no failure state

The 429 rolled the card straight back to 确认修改 / 调整方案 — indistinguishable from a card still waiting for the user, so nothing said the click had failed, and clicking again bought the same refusal.

A quota refusal now parks the card on an explicit blocked state: the existing "not applied" badge, the server's own sentence (which names both exits — tomorrow's reset and the upgrade), and the upgrade action when the host wired one. Ranked BELOW the three server verdicts (published / failed / drafted), so a real outcome always outranks a client-side refusal.

The rollback itself stays for transient failures (offline, per-minute rate limit) — retrying is the right next step there, and that split is pinned. Copy comes from the shared `useAiQuotaCopy` helper the composer banner now also uses, so one 429 cannot be described by two different sentences on the same screen. **No new i18n keys** — it reuses `chatbotQuota.*`.

## 3. The composer was refilled with an already-delivered message

The generic "restore my typing" path, not a quota-specific one, as the dispatch asked me to determine. `handleSubmit` writes `lastSubmittedRef`; the card buttons send canned text and never touched it, so a failed card send restored the user's PREVIOUS prompt — one the agent had already answered — reading as "resend this".

Fixed at the general behaviour rather than by branching on the error code: only text the user typed into the composer is restorable now. `handleChangesConfirm`, `handlePlanApprove` and `handleSuggestionClick` clear the slot. Restoring genuinely unsent typing is untouched, and is pinned.

## Tests

New:
- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.quotaBlockedConfirm.test.tsx` — the 429 (real ADR-0112 envelope + `notSent`/`status` tags) blocks the card, does not refill the composer, and the CTA fires `onUpgrade`; plus the no-`onUpgrade` shape and the transient-failure control.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/cloudConsoleUrl-7253.test.ts` — the URL is the origin verbatim and carries no `/apps/`, no slug, no object route. The assertions pin the ABSENCE of a composed path, so a later "improvement" that appends one turns red.

Both ablated from the committed state, mutation confirmed on disk by blob hash and marker counts, restore confirmed byte-identical (`git diff HEAD` empty):
- ChatbotEnhanced.tsx at `origin/main` (markers `quotaBlockedChanges` / `QuotaBlockedNextStep` counted 0) → 4 of 5 red; the 5th is the unchanged-behaviour control and is correctly green both ways.
- `cloudConsoleUrl` mutated to append the old path → 4 of 4 red.

Green at `2d5e311ac`:
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` → 596 passed, 1 failed. The failure is `anonSeedScope-5746.enumeration.test.tsx`, and it is NOT from this change: with all five source files this PR touches checked out at `origin/main` the same 7 tests fail identically, and they pass on Node 22.22.3 (what CI pins) while failing on this container's Node 26.7.0. Filed as #7271.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/` (inside a 72-file run with the marketplace + layout suites) → 672 passed, 0 failed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` and `... plugin-chatbot type-check` → both exit 0 with the script name echoed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` (`dist completeness: 898 emitted files verified`) and `... plugin-chatbot build` → 0.
- `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys` → all print their own OK line.
- `check-changeset-presence` → `✅ 11 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`; `check-changeset-no-major` → `✅`.

**Declared narrowing on lint.** Both packages the diff touches were linted in full via their own `lint` script (`eslint .`): app-shell 1046 files, 0 errors; plugin-chatbot 62 files, 0 errors — counts read from `--format json`, not from my sense of what should be in scope. Untouched packages were not linted locally; that is safe here because `eslint.config.js` configures no `parserOptions.project` (no type-aware linting), so this diff cannot move a verdict on a file it does not contain. CI runs `turbo run lint` over all of them regardless.

**Not measured locally:** `check:readme-exports` needs every package built. After building app-shell and plugin-chatbot it reports zero unjudged self-imports for both; the 61 remaining lines are other packages' unbuilt `dist`, i.e. a prerequisite of my local run, not a finding.
